name: Nugget Slugs
summary: Nugget Slugs is a quest in the northern Barrens given by the eccentric tinkerer Wenikee Boltbucket. Eager to repair and experiment on a recovered samophlange, she tasks adventurers with raiding the nearby Venture Company drilling operations at the Sludge Fen for spare parts.

sections.title: Wenikee's Engineering Needs
sections.body: Having come into possession of an intricate samophlange, Wenikee Boltbucket is determined to tinker with the strange machine and see how it works. However, precise goblinoid mechanics demand very specific hardware. Lacking the materials herself, Wenikee sends runners to pilfer seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs from the local Venture Company work crews, who carelessly leave their heavy tool buckets lying around the nearby Sludge Fen oilworks.

sections.title: A Volatile Breakthrough
sections.body: Gathering fifteen of the specialized metal slugs requires dodging Venture Company operators and deforesters tearing through the marshes east of the road. Once the hardware is delivered, Wenikee wastes no time setting the samophlange on the ground to begin immediate adjustments. True to goblin engineering form, the volatile combination of mismatched parts and hasty assembly results in a sudden, catastrophic explosion—leaving Wenikee shaken but remarkably undeterred.

faq.answer: In goblin engineering parlance, nugget slugs are small, standardized metallic fasteners or ammunition components. Wenikee specifically requires seventeen-point-five gauge slugs to interface with the delicate internal gears of the samophlange.

Wenikee Boltbucket is an independent tinkerer camping out along the main trail in the northern Barrens. She has an obsessive curiosity with intricate mechanical contraptions, particularly samophlanges, regardless of the obvious safety hazards involved.

faq.q: Where are the nugget slugs found?
faq.answer: They are scavenged from tool buckets scattered around the Sludge Fen, an industrialized logging and oil extraction camp run by the Venture Company directly east of Wenikee's small roadside campsite.

faq.q: What happens when Wenikee repairs the samophlange?
faq.answer: As soon as Wenikee receives the parts and begins wrenching on the machine, it overloads and detonates directly in her face, demonstrating the dangerously volatile nature of poorly calibrated machinery.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company at the Sludge Fen?
faq.answer: The Venture Company established the Sludge Fen to strip-mine and extract oil and natural resources from the marshlands of the Barrens, polluting the surrounding landscape with heavy drill rigs and refineries.

faq.q: Does this quest unlock any further tasks?
faq.answer: Nugget Slugs is the concluding task in Wenikee's brief errand chain. Following the explosive failure of her repair attempt, she has no further assignments for adventurers.

angles.text: Any practicing engineer will recognize the telltale warning signs of goblin handiwork long before Wenikee's hasty repairs blow up in her face.
The Venture Company's invasive operations at the Sludge Fen are a persistent environmental nuisance to the Horde, making any excuse to steal their supplies a welcome one.
